text:
renee: heads-up: Ellie's birthday next Wed 4pm. thinking tiny mixers in the lounge? :confetti_ball:
ellie: honestly low-key please, i just want snacks :blush:
matt: vote: :chips: snack spread / :cupcake: cupcakes / :e-gift: e-gift for remote teammates
zoe: :chips: (less sugary for the 3pm slump)
dave: can we do a mini playlist too? ellie always has good recs
hr-bot: Reminder: Ellie's Birthday 5 Wed 16:00-16:20. Add to calendar: https://calendar.redwood/evt/1894567000
renee: quick poll closes Tue noon. current: 1 chips, 0 cupcakes, 0 e-gift
matt: dietary note: add a gluten-free snack option if possible
zoe: i'll bring a small bowl of mixed nuts (labelled) and napkins
renee: awesome. thoughts on adding a tiny plant card or a charity donation envelope?
ellie: no pressure on gifts, but a small plant would be sweet :seedling:
dave: i'll make a 15-song birthday playlist and share a link on Wed morning
renee: plan so far: snack spread (zoe + matt), labeled GF options, playlist (dave), card (renee). remote folks: prefer e-gift or surprise zoom? reply :e-gift: / :zoom:
matt: :e-gift:
zoe: :zoom:
renee: hr-bot, please post RSVP and calendar invite to #all-hands for remote join link
hr-bot: Calendar updated: Ellie's Birthday 5 (Add to your calendar: https://calendar.redwood/evt/1894567000)
renee: can folks drop 1-2 lines for the card here? i'll paste and sign
matt: "Thanks for being my go-to pair on perf tests. You make tricky stuff easy."
zoe: "Your playlists = office gold. Happy birthday!"
dave: "Keep being curious and kind. Happy day!"
ellie: you folks are the best, not sure this is a surprise but i'm touched <3
renee: pickup checklist: snacks (matt, zoe), card + marker (renee), playlist (dave), cleanup help (volunteer?)
matt: i can stick around 4:20 to help tidy
renee: perfect. closing thread  thanks everyone :tada:
